pages.title: Oxygen Rebreather
pages.text: A mask, a bottle of oxygen, and a can of caustic soda that soaks up the carbon dioxide you breathe out, so the same oxygen goes round again. Twenty minutes on Titan, where the air is nitrogen and methane.
